lane:
خُشَارٌ (K) and ↓خُشَارَةٌ (S, A, K) The _bad part_ or _parts_ [or the _refuse_] (Lh, S, K) of goods, or commodities, (Lh,) or of anything. (S, K.) And the latter, The _worst kind,_ syn. شِيص, of lates. (A.) === _What contains no_ لُبّ [or _heart_], of barley. (A, K.) === And the latter, The _refuse of food remaining upon a table; that in which is no good._ (S, A, K. *) === Also the latter, (S, A, K,) and the former, (K,) and ↓خُشَّارٌ, (IAar,) ‡ The _refuse,_ or _lowest_ or _basest_ or _meanest sort,_ of mankind, or of people; (IAar, S, A, K;) as also ↓خَاشِرٌ, accord. to the K, but correctly ↓خَاشِرَةٌ, as related by AA from IAar. (TA.) El-Hotei-ah says, 
وَبَاعَ بَنِيهِ بَعْضُهُمْ بِخُشَارَةً
وَبِعْتَ لِذُبْيَانَ العَلَآءَ بِمَالِكِ
 [_And some of them have sold their sons for the refuse of mankind; but_] _thou hast purchased eminence for Dhubyán with Málik:_ in the S we find بِمَالِكَا [_with thy property_]: but it is correctly as above: Málik was a son of 'Oyeyneh Ibn- Hisn: the Benoo-'Ámir slew him: wherefore 'Oyeyneh made war upon them, and obtained his blood-revenge, and spoil: and to this event El- Hotei-ah refers in the verse above. (IB, TA.)

خُشَّارٌ : see the paragraph next preceding.

entries.text: الخشار والخشارة، بضمهما: الرديء من كل شيء، وسفلة الناس، كالخاشر، وما لا لب له من الشعير. وخشر  يخشر: أبقى على المائدة الخشارة، و الشيء: نقى عنه خشارته، ضد، وشره. وكفرح: هرب جبنا. وخشاورة، بالضم: سكة بنيسابور. وذو خشران، بالفتح: من ألهان بن مالك.
